name: evergreen
_note: The Barkpark flagship theme — authored intent ONLY. A theme is a per-mode {bg,ink,accent} skin over the compiler's frozen neutral structure (design/derive.mjs); `overrides` pins the bytes a formula cannot hit today (each with a one-line reason), and `passthrough` declares the theme-INVARIANT families (charter D21) that are deliberately not derived. Adding theme N+1 = one more file exactly like this. check.mjs Part F proves derive(this) === design/tokens.json byte-for-byte and freezes the override count.
